test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 20 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The number of cars passing the road near a colony from 6 am to 12 noon has been shown in the following histogram.

During which hour(s) is the number of cars passed less than the average number of cars passed from 7 am to 12 noon?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ab94f95247f3c7d06333db5d6b36627d7debc631254ca345bf5b046edde3534.png]
solution:
Calculation:

The average of number car passed = (105 + 130 + 115 + 95 + 45) ÷ 5 = 98

Now, the hour(s) is the number of cars passed less than the average number of cars passed from 7 am to 12 noon

⇒ 6-7, 10 -11, 11-12

**∴ The hour(s) is the number of cars passed less than the average number of cars passed from 7 am to 12 noon are 6-7, 10 -11, 11-12**.
